 Paramore's Hayley Williams to bring solo concert tour to Singapore in February 2027
 The Paramore frontwoman will perform in Singapore at The Star Theatre on Feb 26, 2027, as part of The Hayley Williams Show, which focuses on her solo music. 
 The Hayley Williams Show kicked off in September 2026. (Photo: AP/Rick Scuteri)

 Paramore's vocalist and frontwoman Hayley Williams is bringing her solo concert tour, The Hayley Williams Show, to Singapore on Feb 26, 2027 at The Star Theatre.
 Organised by AEG Presents Asia, Williams' Asian leg of the show will also make stops in Manila, Seoul and Tokyo. 
 The artist presale will begin on Wednesday (Nov 18) at 12pm until Nov 19 at 11.59pm, while the general sale will be on 20 Nov at 12PM. 
 Tickets can be purchased through AXS Tickets Singapore's official website . 
 Best known as the lead vocalist of rock band Paramore, Williams has also built a solo career with releases including Petals For Armor in 2020 and Ego Death At A Bachelorette Party in 2025. 
 In a June interview with iHeartRadio, Williams said the solo tour would have a "very different set or different energy" compared with her previous performances.
 Unlike her performances with Paramore, The Hayley Williams Show focuses on her solo material, with previous setlists featuring songs from both albums, alongside occasional covers.
 During earlier performances, Williams also revisited Airplanes, the 2010 hit by American rapper B.o.B on which she was featured.
 The tour was initially announced in April 2026, with dates in New York City, Los Angeles and Sao Paulo, before expanding to other cities across North America, Latin America and Europe.
 Earlier this year, Williams also embarked on her Hayley Williams At A Bachelorette Party solo tour, which ran from March to June. She also previously performed with Paramore as a supporting act for selected shows on Taylor Swift's The Eras Tour in 2023 and 2024.
